_: Copy to <repo>/.checkup.json and fill in. Every field is this repo's data; check_map.py holds no repo knowledge. Field notes are in SKILL.md.
_path_roots: Roots a `## Code` path may be written against, in order. A repo whose notes address crates by name (`pkg-pdu/src/x.rs`) while the tree has a `crates/` prefix needs both -- getting this wrong reports every path in the map as missing.
_source_globs: Everything a `## Code` bullet may name a symbol in. Also the file index that resolves a bare name (`walk.rs`) or a partial path (`src/selection.rs`) written in prose.
_comment_globs: Source files whose COMMENTS are scanned for cited repo paths. Leave empty to skip that check entirely; a non-empty list that matches nothing is reported as a failure, not a pass.
_command_words: First words that mark a backticked token as a shell command to skip, not a path.
_kinds: One entry per note kind. `match` is a regex against the note's repo-relative path; `sections` is the exact heading set that kind must carry. Empty sections are load-bearing -- a note may not drop the heading to hide the hole -- so this is the schema, not a style guide.
_aggregate: Optional. A note starting with `marker` owns no detail, so it is exempt from the section set and must say so. Omit if this map has no aggregates.
_owned_value_patterns: Values another artifact owns and a note may not restate. A decision record's status is the usual one: the copy has no gate, the record's own line does.
_reciprocity: Optional. Every note `from` claims must claim it back, plus dangling references both ways. That direction is load-bearing: a reader lands on the territory and reads its list as a checklist, so an invariant the list omits is invisible exactly when it is needed.
_reciprocity_both_ways: Opt-in, and off by default, because the argument above does not symmetrise. An invariant's own section is a roster of SITES, and a territory may name it as its origin or as context without being one. Turn this on only for a map whose rosters are exhaustive by design.
